moments.title: European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Birmingham is hosting the European Athletics Championships from August 10-16, marking the first time the UK has staged this prestigious event, with over 1,500 elite athletes competing at the Alexander Stadium.

angles.name: Live Action Update
angles.copy: Athletics fever is gripping Birmingham! The European Athletics Championships are LIVE all week – who are you cheering for?

angles.name: UK Hosting Pride
angles.copy: History in the making! The UK is hosting the European Athletics Championships for the very first time, right here in Birmingham. What a week for sport!

moments.title: FA Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield kicks off the football season on Sunday, August 16th, with Premier League champions Arsenal facing FA Cup holders Manchester City at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Football Season Opener
angles.copy: Cardiff is hosting the curtain-raiser! The Community Shield hits Principality Stadium this Sunday. Arsenal vs Man City – who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Welsh Host City
angles.copy: Huge football coming to Cardiff! Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this Sunday. Get ready, Wales!

moments.title: EFL Championship Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026-2027 EFL Championship season begins on Friday, August 14th, with clubs across England and Wales starting their campaign for promotion.

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The EFL Championship kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for promotion this season?

angles.name: Wrexham's First Game
angles.copy: Wrexham are back in action! Their Championship campaign begins Monday against Cardiff City. Huge week for Welsh football!

moments.title: Premier League Season Details Announced
moments.blurb: The Premier League has confirmed the 2026/27 season will start on August 22nd and end on May 30th, 2027, with fixtures already released.

angles.name: Fixture Buzz
angles.copy: It's official: the Premier League returns August 22nd! Have you checked your team's opening fixtures yet?

moments.title: Boomtown Fair This Week
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Fair festival, known for its unique narrative and diverse music, runs from August 12-16 near Winchester.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Boomtown Fair kicks off tomorrow! Get ready for a week of incredible music, art and immersive storytelling near Winchester. Who's heading to 'Chapter 4: The Twin Trail'?

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: The gates to Boomtown open tomorrow! Five days of electronic beats, hidden stages, and pure festival magic. Expect the unexpected.

moments.title: Fairport's Cropredy Convention
moments.blurb: Fairport's Cropredy Convention, the long-running folk and rock festival, takes place in Oxfordshire from August 13-15.

angles.name: Folk Rock Institution
angles.copy: It's almost time for Cropredy! Fairport's legendary festival begins Thursday, bringing the best of folk and rock to Oxfordshire. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Madonna's Birthday
moments.blurb: The iconic 'Queen of Pop' Madonna turns 68 on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop Celebration
angles.copy: Strike a pose! The one and only Madonna turns 68 on Saturday. What's your ultimate Madonna anthem?

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has consistently redefined pop music. Happy early birthday to the legend turning 68 this weekend!

moments.title: Joe Jonas's Birthday
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter and actor Joe Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, turns 37 on Thursday, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 37th birthday to Joe Jonas this Thursday! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us so many bops. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Sarah Brightman's Birthday
moments.blurb: British classical crossover soprano and actress Sarah Brightman turns 66 on Thursday, August 14th.

angles.name: Soprano Star
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the incredible Sarah Brightman tomorrow! Her voice is pure magic. What's your favourite performance?

moments.title: Ben Gibbard's Birthday
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, frontman of Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service, turns 50 today, August 11th.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Ben Gibbard! A true indie icon from Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service. Spin a classic in his honour today!

moments.title: Sir Mix-A-Lot's Birthday
moments.blurb: American rapper and producer Sir Mix-A-Lot, famous for 'Baby Got Back', turns 63 on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Rap Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Sir Mix-A-Lot turns 63! You know the song, you know the beat. What's your favourite 90s hip-hop track?

moments.title: Roy Hay (Culture Club) Birthday
moments.blurb: Roy Hay, guitarist and keyboardist for the iconic 80s band Culture Club, turns 65 on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Karma Chameleon! Happy 65th birthday to Culture Club's Roy Hay tomorrow. What's your favourite track from the legendary band?

moments.title: James Morrison's Birthday
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for hits like 'You Give Me Something', turns 42 on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Soulful Singer
angles.copy: You Give Me Something... to celebrate! Happy 42nd birthday to James Morrison tomorrow. What's his song that always gets you?

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays Ongoing
moments.blurb: The summer school holidays are in full swing across most of the UK, with many families enjoying their breaks before schools return in late August or early September.

angles.name: Summer Vibes
angles.copy: Still soaking up those summer holidays? Whether you're staycationing or abroad, hope you're making the most of it!

angles.name: Back to School Countdown
angles.copy: Enjoying the last few weeks of summer freedom? The countdown to back-to-school is on for many across the UK!
